student.title: Student price
student.intro: If you study at a secondary school, a vocational college or university, you pay less for Plus, Max and group plans for 12 months.
student.institutionPh: For example, IES Pau Vila or University of Seville
student.emailHint: If you have one from your school, it helps us review it sooner.
student.photo: Photo of your student card or enrolment
student.photoHint: JPG, PNG or PDF up to 3 MB. Your name, school and year should be visible.
student.privacy: Only the E-Trading team sees the document, and we delete it as soon as we decide.
student.sentBody: We'll let you know in the app. Meanwhile, keep learning as usual.
student.pendingBody: We got your request from {institution} on {date}. We'll let you know in the app.
student.activeBody: Until {date}. It applies when you pay for Plus, Max or a group plan.
student.renewNote: Less than 30 days left: you can renew it with this year's document.
student.rejectedTitle: We couldn't approve your last request
student.left: {n, plural, one {You have 1 request left this month.} other {You have # requests left this month.}}
student.none: You've made 3 requests this month. You can apply again later.
student.guest: Save your progress with an email and password to apply for the student price.

errors.INSTITUTION_REQUIRED: Write the name of your school or university.
errors.FILE_REQUIRED: Attach a photo of your student card or enrolment.
errors.FILE_TOO_BIG: The file is over 3 MB. Try a lighter photo or PDF.
errors.FILE_TYPE: Upload a JPG or PNG photo, or a PDF.
errors.REQUEST_PENDING: You already have a request under review. We'll let you know within 24-48 h.
errors.ALREADY_STUDENT: You already have the student price.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: At most 3 requests a month. Try again later.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment.
errors.INTERNAL: It couldn't be sent. Try again.

group.title: Group plan
group.headline: One pays, the whole group learns
group.intro: Plus or Max for the whole group: everyone with their own account, progress and portfolio. You also get your own league.
group.name: Group name
group.ownerSeat: You get the plan too and take one of the seats.
group.ownPaidNote: You already pay for your own subscription. Once the group is active, you can cancel it in Settings and keep the group plan.
group.note: Secure payment with Stripe. It renews automatically and you can cancel any time from here.
group.pendingBanner: Your group isn't paid yet. Check the details and pay to activate it.
group.payCanceled: You left checkout without finishing. You haven't been charged.
group.payPending: Your bank is still confirming the payment. It usually takes a few seconds.
group.payExpired: That payment wasn't completed. You haven't been charged.
group.paidBody: Share the link so people can join. Everyone joins with their own account.
group.seatsUnlimited: {used, plural, one {1 person} other {# people}} · no limit
group.pastDueOwner: We couldn't charge the group. It keeps going for a few days while we retry: check your card in “Manage payment”.
group.pastDueMember: There's a problem with the group payment. The person who pays has been told.
group.inviteBody: Whoever opens the link joins the group and your league. If they don't have an account yet, they join after the welcome steps.
group.shareText: Join my group “{name}” on E-Trading and learn to invest with {plan}: {link}
group.full: The group is full. Remove someone to make room.
group.removeBody: They'll lose the group plan and won't be able to rejoin with the link.
group.removed: Done. Their seat is free again.
group.manageHint: Card, invoices or cancel the group.
group.ownMode: You already pay for your own subscription and it stays the same. If you like, cancel it in Settings: you'll keep the group plan.
group.leaveBody: You'll lose the group plan. If you had a gift running, you go back to it.
group.guest: Save your progress with an email and password to create a group.
group.terms: By paying you accept the <terms>Terms of purchase</terms>.

errors.OWNER_CANNOT_LEAVE: You pay for the group: to end it, cancel the payment in “Manage payment”.
errors.PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE: Payments are being set up. Try again in a while.

join.body: Join the group and you'll have {plan} without paying anything, with your own account, progress and portfolio. You also join the group league.

join.notActive: This group isn't active yet: the person who pays has to finish checkout. Open the link again in a while.
join.badLinkBody: The group doesn't exist or has ended. Ask whoever sent it for a new link.
join.finishOnboarding: Finish the welcome steps and we'll add you to the group.
join.afterAuth: When you're done, we'll add you to the group automatically.
join.guest: Save your progress with an email and password to join the group.
